title: Surjectivity of canonical pointed evaluation
statement: Let Y, Ω, barY and hΩ be as in [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-point-evaluation-image]. The concrete ring map from the chosen coordinate-ring colimit C to the relative separable closure of the image point residue field, obtained by restricting the codomain of canonical evaluation using that image theorem, is surjective. No local-ring structure on C is assumed.

proof.text: Choose an affine chart through the geometric point and lift the point through its open immersion. Apply strictHenselization_triples to obtain a colimit c and its surjective residue map ψ to the chart relative separable closure.
Apply strictHenselizationPointEvaluation_comparison to c and ψ. Its colimit isomorphism e preserves evaluation into Ω.

The open immersion gives the base-to-chart residue-field isomorphism b. The factorization of the point, descResidueField_stalkClosedPointTo_comp and hΩ show that b respects the embeddings into Ω. Transfer separability of an arbitrary element y of the base relative closure along b with IsSeparable.of_equiv_equiv. Regard its same value in Ω as an element of the chart relative closure, take its preimage z under ψ, and use e.inv z. Compatibility gives equality in Ω, and subtype extensionality gives equality in the codomain-restricted evaluation map.
